sections.title: 5 · Hearts adrift: Part 1
sections.overview:
This is the only non-joyful moment in the polka. Some polka on the circle, a dip, then F escape, L sad, they reunite and all is well again.
Mood is worried, scared

sections.title: 9 · Triumphant grid crossing
sections.overview:
Start in L grid and F grid next to each other, grids gallop through each other, then reunite into 1 grid. Do some cascade dips on the grid.

Demo videos:
Grid cascades up to plank lift,
rows: L and F grids cross each other diagonally. L column always in front.
Grids start going towards each other
Grids reunite on 2, L turn around on 3-4

sections.title: 10 · 4×4 grid cascades
sections.overview:
Start in L grid and F grid next to each other, grids gallop through each other, then reunite into 1 grid. Do some cascade dips on the grid.

Rollover dip: move hands up from hips to near shoulder blades. Not up in the armpits, but close. Then for the turn, use your hands to help rotate the follow over their left shoulder, and keep right hand in position so as they turn, your right arm ends up wrapped all the way around F, holding them up with right forearm under their shoulders (not waist).
4-point cascade: Rollover dip. Hits on the 1/2/3/4, so you should start the beat prior.

sections.title: 11 · Unfurling pyramid
sections.overview:
On every beat 4, a different row is reaching their final pyramid position (leads put right foot down), and the follows hit their snappy send out on the following beat 1.
The final pyramid position is denoted by the location where the lead plants their left foot.
Mood: grand, expansive, epic

sections.title: 12 · V finale
sections.overview: Snappy sendout cascade, pinwheel cascade, triangle lift, end in deep dip
rows: Pause in frame, be ready for sendout
8-point sendout cascade (on the half notes), back to front
Pinwheel prep: F outside arm goes on top (different for left and right sides)

8-point pinwheel cascade (on the half notes), front to back. The “down” for pinwheel will be the half note before your cascade count. Example: front couples “down” on the “and” of the last beat of measure 2.
Music tempo changes to significantly slower right here! Be prepared
Get out of pinwheel end and prep for triangle lift (quick turnaround!). “Down” on 4.
Triangle lift: up on 1, do 2 full 360deg rotations in 2 measures
Pause in triangle lift for 1-2, put down and prep for dip 3-4
Shallow part of dip hit on 1, deep dip on 2 (the last note of the music is on the 2)
